correctness.rationale: The monomial norm ∫|z|^{2n}dμ=(n+1)^(−α−1) is calculated from the exact logarithmic measure, including Hardy α=−1 separately. On E={|φ|≤r} and F={|ψ|≤r}, corresponding restricted high-degree composition tails have Hilbert–Schmidt norm at most B_N(r); Q_N(Cψ* Cφ)Q_N has operator norm ≤(‖Cφ‖+‖Cψ‖)B_N. The complement has rank ≤2N, yielding the claimed s_(2N+1) upper estimate, then asymptotic √δ and all p>0. Compact closure of linear-fractional symbols identifies δ<1 with disjoint contacts; Clifford–Zheng theorem and linear radial deficits exclude compactness at common contacts. The N→∞ bound, not the 225 exact finite moment checks, proves the ideal membership. δ=0 implies one constant map by the analytic identity theorem.
